failure_summary.description: Both answers chose a plausible but non-target response: an unnecessary event qualifier instead of the conventional event name, and a generic kinship relation instead of the shared place indicated by context.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directs the agent to return the minimal conventional answer and, for bare lists of people, use context to identify the distinctive shared relation rather than defaulting to a generic one. These failures reflect not applying those rules, so adding similar guidance would duplicate existing content.
